title: Desk Note: The Short-Stay Cleaning Fee on Roamhaven Listings and the Host's Fee Editor
content:
# Desk Note — The Short-Stay Cleaning Fee

Covers requests from hosts of Roamhaven Listings to set a short-stay cleaning fee on a listing.

## Why the fee exists

The short-stay cleaning fee exists to keep one- and two-night stays affordable, and a short-stay guest who brings a pet pays the pet fee on the same stay, so the per-stay fees of a listing are judged together.

## When the short-stay ceiling is fixed and when the fee is added

> The short-stay ceiling is fixed only after the regular cleaning fee on the listing stands at or below the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.

> A short-stay cleaning fee is not added to a listing until the pet fee on that listing stands at or below the listing's pet-fee ceiling.

| What the listing record shows | Consequence for the short-stay cleaning fee |
|---|---|
| the regular cleaning fee on the listing stands above the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling | the short-stay ceiling is not yet fixed |
| the regular cleaning fee on the listing stands at or below the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling | the short-stay ceiling can be fixed |
| the pet fee on the listing stands above the listing's pet-fee ceiling | a short-stay cleaning fee is not added to the listing |
| the pet fee on the listing stands at or below the listing's pet-fee ceiling | this condition no longer holds the fee back |

## The host's own tool: `save_short_stay_cleaning_fee_f18844b5`

**Capability.** From the host's own listing editor, the host saves the short-stay cleaning fee of one of their listings. The listing's short-stay cleaning fee is overwritten with the amount the host enters; from then on, new bookings of that listing short enough to qualify are charged it in place of the regular cleaning fee, while stays already booked keep the cleaning fee frozen on them. When the amount differs from the short-stay cleaning fee the listing carried at the moment of the save, one fee-change record is added to the listing's history with the old amount, the new amount and today's date; an unchanged amount logs nothing.

**How it is invoked.** The short-stay cleaning fee is the host's own setting. Support unlocks the host's tool `save_short_stay_cleaning_fee_f18844b5` and hands it over; the host — the customer themselves — runs it from their own listing editor.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | the reference number of the host's own listing whose short-stay cleaning fee is saved, as read out to the host by support from the listing lookup | the listing reference number |
| `short_stay_cleaning_fee` | the cleaning fee charged once per short stay | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before saving; 0.00 means no short-stay cleaning fee is set |

**Return.** A receipt carrying `listing_id` (the listing reference number), `setting` (always `short_stay_cleaning_fee`), `previous_amount` (the short-stay cleaning fee the listing carried when the host saved, USD to 2 decimal places), `new_amount` (the short-stay cleaning fee now saved, USD to 2 decimal places), `change_logged` (true when a fee-change record was added), `change_record_id` (the reference number of that record, empty when nothing was logged) and `saved_on` (the date of the save, YYYY-MM-DD). The host sees the short-stay cleaning fee on the listing as soon as the receipt comes back; a receipt carrying the new amount means the fee is in force.

## Questions the note answers

**While the pet fee on a listing stands above the listing's pet-fee ceiling, is a short-stay cleaning fee added to that listing?**
No. A short-stay cleaning fee is not added to a listing until the pet fee on that listing stands at or below the listing's pet-fee ceiling.

**Is the short-stay ceiling fixed on a regular cleaning fee that stands above the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling?**
No. The short-stay ceiling is fixed only after the regular cleaning fee on the listing stands at or below the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.
